pm_rationale: ISRG has become severely dislocated from fundamentals, trading at 2nd percentile vs equal-weight healthcare despite maintaining strong growth and market dominance. Technical oversold condition presents asymmetric risk/reward with 32% analyst target upside.
portfolio_thesis: Market is treating ISRG as a cyclical medical device company rather than a structural growth story. Consensus appears focused on near-term procedure volume volatility and macro headwinds, missing the long-term robotics adoption curve and expanding addressable procedures. We see temporary dislocation in a dominant platform with pricing power.
